title: Pure Fluffal
summary: Pure Fluffal, Edge Imp, and Frightfur Fusion combo build, uniting Sora Perse's cute stuffed animals and sinister fiendish blades with staples. The deck generates staggering hand and field advantage through Toy Vendor discarding and searching loops, assembling lethal multi-attacking and board-wiping Frightfur Fusion bosses.

summary.title: Starters & Searchers
points: Fluffal Dog searches any Fluffal monster or Edge Imp Sabres from your Deck on Normal or Special Summon from the hand.
Frightfur Patchwork adds both Polymerization and any Edge Imp monster directly from your Deck to your hand.
Fluffal Bear discards itself to Set Toy Vendor directly from the Deck to the field, and can be tributed to retrieve Polymerization from the GY.
Fluffal Owl searches Polymerization on Normal or Special Summon, or pays 500 LP to Fusion Summon a Frightfur directly without using a Spell.

summary.title: Opening: Fluffal Dog + Fluffal Bear
steps: Discard Fluffal Bear to place Toy Vendor directly from your Deck onto the field.
Normal Summon Fluffal Dog to search Edge Imp Chain (or Fluffal Dolphin) from your Deck.
Activate Toy Vendor, discarding Edge Imp Chain to draw 1 card; Chain triggers in the GY to search Frightfur Patchwork.
Activate Frightfur Patchwork to add Polymerization and Edge Imp Sabres to your hand.
Activate Polymerization to fuse Fluffal Dog and Edge Imp Sabres into Frightfur Cruel Whale, triggering Whale to pop a card and mill Fluffal Repair to extend into Frightfur Sabre-Tooth.

summary.title: Toy Vendor Loop
points: Toy Vendor allows you to discard 1 card once per turn to draw 1 card; if it is a Fluffal, you Special Summon a monster from hand, otherwise it is sent to the GY.
When Toy Vendor is sent to the GY, it searches any Fluffal monster or Edge Imp Sabres from your Deck.
Fluffal Dolphin Sets a Toy Vendor directly from your GY and sends a Fluffal monster or Edge Imp Sabres from your Deck to the GY.
Edge Imp Sabres places a card from your hand on top of your Deck to Special Summon itself from the GY, perfectly stacking Toy Vendor's draw.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Frightfur Cruel Whale destroys 1 card on each player's field on Fusion Summon, and mills a Frightfur card from Deck or Extra Deck to boost a Fusion monster.
Frightfur Kraken targets and sends an opponent's monster to the GY without destroying it, and can attack twice each turn.
Frightfur Sabre-Tooth revives a Frightfur monster on Fusion Summon and cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects if summoned using 3 or more materials.
Frightfur Tiger destroys cards on the field up to the number of Fusion Materials used for its summon, and pumps all Frightfur monsters.
Edge Imp Scythe acts as a hand-trap Quick Effect on the opponent's Main Phase to Fusion Summon Frightfur Cruel Whale for immediate disruption.

summary.title: Spells
points: Frightfur Fusion banishes materials from your field or GY to Fusion Summon any Frightfur boss, enabling game-ending follow-ups.
Frightfur Repair returns a banished Frightfur or Frightfur in the GY to the Extra Deck to revive a Fluffal or Edge Imp, and banishes itself to Special Summon from hand.
Toy Parade lets a DARK Fusion Monster make extra attacks on monsters up to the number of monsters Special Summoned from the Extra Deck that turn.
